component.name: Linh
component.summary: Open each link in the browser that fits

description.p: Linh handles HTTP and HTTPS links as your default browser, then opens each link in a browser, browser profile, private window, or supported app. It can also show a picker when you want to choose where a link opens.
Configure routing in Settings to decide what happens before the picker is shown. Rules are checked in order, so the first matching rule chooses the destination.

ul.li: Route links by URL pattern to a browser, profile, private window, or app
Choose a browser in the link picker when no rule matches
Set a primary browser for links that do not need a prompt

screenshot.caption: Configure link routing rules in Settings

description.p: Added signed, user-controlled in-app updates and changed the application ID for store distribution.
Fixed Linux picker repaint corruption and improved Windows Store integration.
Released the cross-platform browser picker with macOS and Windows support.
Introduced the Fedora browser picker, routing rules, and Settings interface.
